description: Nudges the person on their phone or browser at a time of day, on some days of the week, to add a row ("Log your weight"), with a button that opens the form with some answers filled in. skipIfLogged keeps it quiet on a day something was already added. summary sends a short summary of the sheet instead.

days.description: Days of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.

label.description: What it says, like "Log your weight".

preset.description: Answers to fill in, by column key.

time.description: The time of day in the person's timezone, as HH:MM, like 08:30.

name: add_reminder
title: Add a reminder
